freevpn.title: Community VPN Ecosystem
freevpn.subtitle: Access free community configs or earn dedicated VIP servers by contributing to the network.
freevpn.authDesc: You must join our Telegram community and authenticate via the bot to access the free VPN ecosystem.
freevpn.joinChannelDesc: Membership is required. The bot will verify your subscription before authenticating.
freevpn.loginStepDesc: After joining, click "Login with Telegram" above to get a 6-digit code and send it to the bot.
freevpn.scanDesc: To unlock access to the community configs, you must give back to the network. Please run an IP scan and find at least 10 Clean IPs within the last 3 days.
freevpn.vipDesc: Contribute 10,000 successful IP scans to the global database to earn a private 10GB high-speed VIP Config valid for 7 days.
